verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe Smithery handling OAuth flows, encrypted write-only credential storage, and automatic token refresh (smithery-docs-1,2,3,13), and this is corroborated by a live probe showing an OAuth challenge gating a hosted MCP endpoint (smithery-probe-rt-2). missing for 10: no independent hands-on confirmation of encryption-at-rest implementation details or token refresh behavior over time, and community evidence focuses on unrelated security findings rather than corroborating credential vaulting.
